name: Rel.AI MCP
description: Coding-agent tools for ChatGPT web: inspect, search, edit, run, validate, review, and Git against approved local repositories.

connection.note: Create or reconnect the Rel.AI MCP integration in ChatGPT using the Tunnel connection option. Keep the tunnel runtime API key in the Rel.AI desktop app; do not put it in this file.

recommended_first_prompt: Use Rel.AI MCP on the configured workspace. Start a work session, snapshot the repository, and inspect it before modifying files.
